high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a news feed from the Google News app. The top part of the screen shows the time as 1:36 and the battery level at 18%. There is also a search icon on the left and a profile icon on the right. The main content of the image is a news article from "The New Indian Express." The headline reads: "Rs 30 crore chopper is on sale for barely Rs 4 crore in Rajasthan. Find out details." The article was published 17 hours ago. The accompanying image shows a military helicopter in flight, painted in a camouflage green color.
